verdict.rationale: Reducto documents async job processing, presigned uploads up to 5GB, chunking controls, and batch queuing that suggest large-file/long-document support (reducto-docs-9, 16, 21, 25), but a concrete hands-on community report states Reducto 'did struggle with long documents' on 300+ page financial documents, prompting the reporter to switch to another model for accuracy/speed (reducto-comm-7). This is a direct, specific counter-example to the reliability claim for thousand-page-scale documents, not just general skepticism. Missing for 10: no vendor benchmark or case study specifically addressing multi-thousand-page reliability, no rebuttal or fix documented for the reported struggle, no independent confirmation of timeout-free processing at that scale.
